item.tib: spyi 'dul rta dbu dmar chung las byin rlab dbang gi rim pa yid bzhin 'dod 'byung
item.coloph: rma gnyen pom ra'i bse sgrom chung ba'i yang snying / zab gter brgyad kyi yang tig zhi khro yongs rdzogs spyi 'dul gyi dbang khrid yid bzhin 'dod 'byung zhes bya ba 'di/ bla ma snga rabs rnams kyi mdzad byang dang / gzhung la sogs nas bsdu bar byas nas/ dpal ldan bzang po ri ru sum pa g.yung drung rgyal pos bsgrigs pa dge legs 'phel/ 'gal 'khrul zhi khro'i dbyings su bshags/ dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas myur 'thob shog/
